primary_scope.start: after prepare_observation/clock-or-fault setup and snapshot_observations; just lambda call606
primary_scope.end: call returns refusal before record assertions/recovery618
primary_scope.frozen_oracle: 0 model write entries during actual rejected primary; original RESULT_DURABLE/checkpoint refs/classification retained

costs.C_MAIN: exact T20 lambda interval, nested observed adapters count by explicit event scope
costs.C_SUT: Runner modeled Journal/metadata/flush/fsync etc; includes selected setup/main/recovery boundaries; not physical target file IO
costs.C_HARNESS: owned observer +fixtures/assertions/fault scheduling; subset of Child or parent, not third process
costs.C_EVIDENCE: artifact/log/journal-witness IO by owner; subset of owner cost
costs.C_JOB: overlapping aggregate Child/associated processes accounting; excludes parent

non_double_counting: C_CHILD and C_SUPERVISOR disjoint process owner sets. C_MAIN/C_SUT/C_HARNESS/C_EVIDENCE are annotated subsets (overlap possible). C_JOB is overlapping view; never add all seven totals.

coverage.child: initial suspended sample gives lifetime baseline before Python resumes; subsequent successful lifetime counters include bootstrap before query; before/after deltas are narrower
coverage.parent: first sample after preflight/output/launch; lifetime counters at that sample include earlier process work, but stored deltas exclude it; final tail after last sample not covered
coverage.job: BasicAndIo retains former members, bind fresh job; final query before close includes wider period than samples but separate from parent
coverage.current_method: ResourceObserver.sample two process snapshots+fresh Job; sample calls sequential, different timestamps, no atomic phase cut

blind_spots: Python method counts vs native syscalls differ
process IO accounting includes file/network/device categories per API semantics; cache/flush/physical media not equivalent
parent final append/fsync/close and interpreter tail not in last counters
T20 phase/progress memory event trace not persisted
observer can fail before event appended; zero recorded count needs entry/completeness evidence

missing_fields: counter before/after vectors with nested call attribution
